mac.key: ["idle","Mac ↔ apollo, mars's box on Linux (direct 10 GbE, X540)",null]
mac.text: A wired, direct 10 GbE link joins the Mac, a MacBook Pro with an M1 Max and a Thunderbolt 10 GbE adapter, to apollo, which is mars's Linux box with an X540 card. The pair is idle, with no experiment running at the moment.

mars.text: This pair links neo, a Raspberry Pi 5 with 4 GB of memory and an NVMe drive, to mars, a 12-core Ryzen 9 desktop with 32 GB of memory, over a wired gigabit connection. It is idle right now, with no experiment running.

neo.text: The pair neo and vpsb are joined by a wired link. No experiment is running on this link right now, so the card is idle.

neo-ssd.text: neo, a Raspberry Pi 5 with 4 GB of memory and an NVMe drive, is linked to its partner over a local SSD connection. Paused, it asks whether capping neo at 2 CPUs widens xs -a -j4's deficit to rsync -a on cold local copies of real-psample.
